name: The Fairmont Chateau Whistler
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out mountain resort hotel at the foot of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler, with an on-site golf course (official name: Fairmont Chateau Whistler)
best_for: Skiers who want to step onto the slopes from the hotel
Golfers who want a course on the property
Families wanting suites with a living room and sofabed

facts.text: The hotel sits at the foot of Blackcomb Mountain.
The hotel has an on-site mountain golf course.
The hotel's golf course is a Robert Trent Jones Jr. design.
The slopeside pools include a heated lap pool, an indoor/outdoor heated leisure pool and four whirlpools.
Vida Spa is an in-house spa.
The hotel has a slopeside Health Club.
The Wildflower serves a breakfast buffet.
Deluxe Slopeside View rooms look onto Whistler Mountain and the slopes of Blackcomb Mountain.
One-bedroom suites with a living room, double sofabed and fireplace are described as popular family accommodation.

highlights.text: The hotel is a ski-in/ski-out property.
The Fairmont Gold Penthouse is a loft-style suite with 25-foot floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a Juliette balcony.
Fairmont Gold guests get private check-in/out and an exclusive lounge with breakfast and canapes.
The hotel's golf course is a Robert Trent Jones Jr. design.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
The hotel welcomes small pets for a daily fee, and pets are not allowed in the Fairmont Gold Penthouse Suites.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting its luxury resort status.
